name: Grape
overview: Scripture reveals the grape as a significant agricultural product, cultivated in vineyards as early as Noah's time, who planted a vineyard after the flood. The careful cultivation and harvest of grapes are underscored in the law, with instructions to prune and gather fruit, and special observances such as the jubilee year when the vineyard must rest. Grapes also hold spiritual significance, as seen in the Nazarite vow forbidding the consumption of anything from the vine, highlighting the sacredness of the fruit and its products. The abundance and fertility of the land are symbolized by clusters of grapes, like those cut by the Israelites at the brook Eshcol, demonstrating God's provision and blessing.
